# Demo Selenium Rust for NHS Wales

> A beginner-friendly Selenium + Rust demo (using the `thirtyfour` crate)
> that drives a real Chrome browser against the real, live NHS Wales
> website (https://www.nhs.wales/) and runs three real assertion-based
> checks.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): Install and run instructions, and a summary of what the demo tests.
- [Spec](spec/index.md): The exact three test scenarios, selector ids, and expected strings, as the single source of truth.
- [Citation](CITATION.cff): Citation metadata for this software.

## Source

- [main.rs](src/main.rs): The Selenium program that implements the three tests described in the spec.

## Optional

- [NHS Wales](https://www.nhs.wales/): The live website this demo tests against.
- [thirtyfour on crates.io](https://crates.io/crates/thirtyfour): The Rust crate this demo depends on.
